description: A conditional whose results are a bool and a number is an error
notes: The spec's rules only say that number and bool each unify with string, and none names bool with number. But it defines unification as finding a type that all the given types can be converted to, the most general supertype in a lattice, and bool and number both convert safely to string, which would give the string "true". hashicorp/hcl only tries the given types themselves as the result type (unify in cty/convert/unify.go), and neither bool nor number converts to the other, so the conditional fails.
